aboutUs.card1Text: Tutors adapt teaching methods to suit the student's learning style.
aboutUs.card2Text: Students receive help with homework, test preparation, and subject understanding.
aboutUs.card3Text: One-on-one attention from a background-checked, verified tutor boosts confidence and motivation.

beliefs.joinBody: Join our community of passionate tutors - including university students earning while they inspire the next generation. Make learning personal, flexible, and effective.
beliefs.findHeadingMain: the perfect tutor for any subject, anytime.
beliefs.findBody: Discover experienced tutors who match your learning goals and schedule.

ourTeam.heading: Our team believes you deserve only the best learning experience.
ourTeam.body: We're dedicated to helping students and tutors connect through a safe, trusted, easy-to-use platform. Every learner deserves quality education in the comfort of their own home - and every tutor deserves recognition for their effort.

keepInTouch.heading: Take your learning or teaching journey to the next level.
keepInTouch.body: Stay connected with us for updates, tips, and the latest tutoring opportunities. Whether you're a tutor sharing knowledge or a student chasing goals, our community is here to support your growth every step of the way.
